column1: # the bundle display name and the App/IPA artifact base name (Touchline23Packaging); defaults to name
# a bundle identity of its own: it installs beside any other port and keeps its own container
# the same host runs both retail versions; nn::oe::GetDisplayVersion picks the row by main's build ID
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (GLSLC)
# The NPDM declares virtual address memory, but the game never exercises it: in every Mac run (menus and full
# matches) it calls no AllocateAddressRegion (no SVC 0x2E placeholder line) and maps no alias page (no [mem]
# alias line); all its memory is the startup heap. The 4.375 GB alias of the first bring-up was a defensive
# size from the NPDM, and with it the 8 GB block failed to reserve on iOS: without the extended-virtual-addressing
# entitlement a process has about 7.4 GB of address space in all, and nnosInitialize died at the reservation
# (FATAL reserve guest AS; the single-reservation ceiling measured on a real device is 6 GB, see hle_svc.c).
# 5 GB: alias 1.5 GB (node-area headroom) + stack 256 MB + 256 MB offset leave 3 GB for the heap;
# nninitStartup asks for 0xba400000 (2.98 GB), and a Mac match used 2.91 GB of it.
# the NPDM declares 8 MB of system resource
# The shaders are EA archive programs (EASF): both archives are BIG4 members of
# one RomFS file, encrypted with a key the game's own program module carries.
# The GUI's generic engine reads these rows to locate them; the preparation
# itself is scripts/build_fifa23.py, called by any profile with this format.
# Allow dynamic handles; rebuilt Direct arrays use descriptor-pool IDs through reflection.
